transaction.manifestSlotRule: id/rva/patchKind exact catalog slot; expected/before/after proof all equal uppercase SHA256(ASCII slot || ordinal-byte repeated32 || ASCII catalog expectedProof, otherwise expectedBytes); no length or NUL
transaction.abi: void __thiscall(Player*, int32 controllerId, uint32 propagate); ret 8

causality.eachPair: BEGIN before original, END after complete original and actual assignment readback
causality.initialState: both ordinary endpoints BOUND; self uniquely equals one prior Player and index equals its stored ordinal
causality.invalidation: save baseline; advance generation exactly once; emit UNBOUND A then B immediately before primary unassign BEGIN
causality.unassign: native assignment old>=0 -> -1; exact one menu prompt confirmation -1 -> -1 permitted only after slot53
causality.reassign: slot55, same Player/endpoint/ordinal/generation, -1 -> requested key>=0, actual stored key equals request
causality.partialEventFields: same player/endpoint; assignment digest only; topology and device null; no coherent/unique/assignment/HUD/Lua/relation flags; depth0; original0 BEGIN/original1 END
causality.primaryBegin: full baseline relation, phase10, depth0, original0
causality.relationPublication: after the first complete coherent manager return, RELATION_CHANGE slot55 phase10 includes full new relation matching reassign END assignment digest; that manager END topology digest must equal relation topology digest
causality.confirmation: same manager pass candidates A,B then exactly one next consecutive complete manager pass bounds A,B with identical full topology and manager END topology digest
causality.otherEndpoint: same Player/device/assignment as baseline; global topology may change
causality.pending: strict structural identity double-read may retain expected target -1/missing-device only; never publish a binding
causality.ordinaryRouteWitness: only previously qualified local route may be transferred to this generation-local transaction; offline/roster/backend checks remain mandatory

legacyPolicy.mixedGate: common target/equivalence/layout/graph hashes; new sources share exact catalog/plan/verification/producer hashes; only exact approved historical manifest/events/analysis triples exempt from producer revision equality
